CineStories Compliance & Policy

Contact Us

We welcome direct communication from our readers, film distributors, press representatives, and copyright holders. Whether you have an editorial correction, a story recommendation, a technical inquiry, or a copyright inquiry, please use the channels below to connect with the CineStories Editorial Board.

Official Communication Channels

Editorial & General Inquiries: editorial@cinestories.online (Direct: sumits7196@gmail.com)

DMCA & Copyright Inquiries: dmca@cinestories.online

Press, Advertising & Partnerships: editorial@cinestories.online

Guaranteed Response Time: Within 24 to 48 business hours.

Operating Entity & Bureau Details

Publisher: CineStories Digital Media Network
Department: Visual Journalism & Digital Media Desk
Operating Hours: Monday – Friday, 09:00 – 18:00 UTC / IST
Website: https://cinematicbites.com

Guidance for Specific Inquiries

Editorial Corrections

Please include the specific URL of the article or Web Story, the exact passage or slide containing the discrepancy, and reference links (e.g. official studio release or trade publication) so our fact-checking team can rapidly audit and update the piece.

Copyright / DMCA Takedown Inquiries

Please review our statutory requirements listed on our Terms of Service & DMCA page. Ensure your notice contains the full statutory elements mandated under 17 U.S.C. § 512(c)(3) to allow expedited processing.
